Download the matching premade Blades-artwork-pack.zip alongside default.xex.
Extract it into the Blades directory so Assets/blades.xzp is present here.
No conversion is required. See docs/DASHX360-ASSETS.md for sources and attribution.
Optional retail 5766 shared artwork: shrdres.xzp is tried when blades.xzp cannot load.
Missing/invalid resources use embedded fallbacks. Upstream art is in the separate pack.
